question: Find the mean proportional between 22 and 88.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between two numbers is simply the square root of their product.

Mean proportional = √(22 × 88)

Mean proportional = √(22 × 22 × 4)

Mean proportional = 22 × 2 = 44

**∴ The correct answer is 44.**
